feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. The Integrator kept your 0.6 kg layout and the iteration 8 controller unchanged because iteration 8 scored 257.45 and iteration 10 reproduced it exactly. Iteration 9 is the reason not to go lower: at 0.5 kg, oval progress fell from 0.89 to 0.27 and the oval finishes went from 10 of 20 to 0, so the mass cliff lies between 0.5 and 0.6 kg. Iterations 3, 4, 6 and 7 also rejected the 0.10 m track, y 0.06 m, the 16 mm footprint and the inner ±0.04 m spacing, because each cut oval progress. For the controller, the remaining s-bend and slalom edge drift (max_error about 0.0603 m and 0.0615 m with zero line losses) is a controller-response limit, not a sensor-layout one, so it is outside geometry changes. If this race reproduces iteration 8 (oval about 10 of 20 finishes, zero line losses), the layout is settled. If oval progress falls below 0.5 at 0.6 kg, the seed or track is the cause, so keep 0.6 kg rather than moving mass.
requested_changes: Keep mass at 0.6 kg with the iteration 8 layout (outer ±0.06 m, inner ±0.03 m, y 0.04 m, 12 mm footprints, 0.12 m track, 0.03 m radius). Iteration 8 scored 257.45, iteration 10 reproduced it, and iteration 9 at 0.5 kg collapsed oval progress to 0.27.

Do not move mass below 0.6 kg in any further design. The 0.5 kg result (iteration 9, score 81.24) rules it out, and an untested step such as 0.55 kg carries the same collapse risk if it is not measured first.

Do not retry inner ±0.04 m (iteration 7 oval progress 0.22), the 16 mm footprint (iteration 6 oval progress 0.51), the 0.10 m track (iteration 3 oval progress 0.14) or y 0.06 m (iteration 4 oval progress 0.20). Each was rejected by measured evidence.
